newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee regains lustre as funds buy.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee regains lustre as funds buy.

text.p: Robusta futures broke above their immediate tight band to end Wednesday midsession sharply up, chased by renewed fund buying as the advance triggered buy-stops.
The fund buying was earlier preceded by trade buying on the back of friendly U.S. green coffee stock data released late on Tuesday.
Traders said more fund buying was expected in the afternoon which could help sustain the morning's rise. Origin offers were noticeably absent this morning.
Benchmark May stood $52 up at $1,630 a tonne, the highest in two weeks, and just off its session high of $1,635. Most-active July posted a bigger gain of $60 at $1,655.
Prior to this, the May contract has been confined to a tight range of $1,540 and $1,610 as the market tried to build a base after tumbling from its recent peak just above $1,800.
London had opened slightly down after overnight losses in New York.
News of a much smaller-than-expected increase in U.S. March Green Coffee Association stocks came after the close of New York trading.

The data showed a modest rise of 111,000 60-kg bags, well below earlier market expectations of 200,000 to 300,000 bag increase. There was even talk earlier in the day that the stocks would increase by 700,000 bags.
The end-February stocks totalled 1.54 million bags.
"This should therefore be seen as positive, but there will undoubtedly be some talk that the difference will show up next month," broker GNI said in a daily commentary.
